then.text: Off you go to the stage on the prom, and wait for dusk! I've told the compère. I've told everyone. I'm very proud. I'll be at the back, crying into a barm cake.
Doreen needs a celebrity for the switch-on? Well, I was on the telly in 1983. Briefly. On the news. For the wrong reasons.
No, love. You do it. But a Blackpool celebrity has to know their Blackpool. Three questions. Ready?
When did eight arc lamps first light the prom, the 'artificial sunshine'?
How many piers does Blackpool have?
Three out of three! You're a natural. Right: you're our stand-in. I'll ring the compère. Go to the stage on the prom by the Tower at dusk and throw that switch!

else.text: Ooh, no. North, Central and South: three piers, the only town in Britain with three. Have another go when you're ready.
No, love. It was the Eiffel Tower. Blackpool's mayor went to Paris in 1889 and came back with ideas. Try again.
Not quite. 1879: eight arc lamps, 'artificial sunshine'. 1912 is when the Illuminations proper began. Try again.
Uncle Norman, comedian, Blackpool's finest, on in the second half. I've played the Winter Gardens, the piers, the Tower Circus once when the clown was ill.

Here's one. A man walks into the Tower Ballroom with a pork pie on his head. The organist says, 'You've got a pork pie on your head.' He says, 'Not usually, it's a cheese and onion one, but it's my day off.' Thank you, I'm here all week.
